message: The other day, my spouse and I were cleaning out the garage when we stumbled upon the go-bags I had packed a while back. I remember how I got a few eye rolls when I first mentioned it—"Oh, come on, Stacy, we live in a safe neighborhood!" Fast forward to that unexpected storm warning, and I couldn’t help but feel a little smug when I said, "Well, at least we’re ready!" It's those little moments that remind me how nice it is to be prepared, even if it feels unnecessary at times. What’s your favorite preparedness tip that’s come in handy? 🌟
